verdict.rationale: stagewise's built-in agent reads the user's workspace files, attached browser tabs, and connected sources such as Supabase. It proposes edits the user can accept or reject inline, so AI-generated suggestions grounded in the user's own project data happen inside the product. However, this is framed as a coding agent rather than a dedicated insights feature, and nothing documents analytical insights or summaries surfaced from data. Missing for 10: an explicit insights or summary capability over user data, documented analysis output beyond code edits, independent hands-on corroboration of insight quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: stagewise is a standalone desktop IDE where AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces.
Accept, reject, or undo every agent edit with full inline diffs
